headline: Cal State LA stand alone among the unbeaten
dek: Cal State LA have won thirteen of their fourteen matches and drawn the other, conceding four goals in all. Cal State San Bernardino, the only other side that had not lost, have since been beaten by UC Merced and Cal State Monterey Bay.
displaced_by: Cal State LA have now conceded four, and Cal State San Bernardino have lost twice, so the standing headline and dek are no longer true.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fresno Pacific have scored 37 goals, more than any other programme, and have still lost eight of their sixteen matches; in this conference, goals scored and results have tracked each other loosely at best.

wire.line: Cal State LA are the only side yet to lose, and their next trip is to Cal State San Bernardino.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches have passed their date with no result recorded, every one of them in August; the latest is Chico State's match with Yuba.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State East Bay have conceded 44 goals in fifteen matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Stanislaus State have drawn six of their fifteen matches, more draws than any other side in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Zion Vaughn has scored ten of Fresno Pacific's 37 goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Yoel Vazquez has kept five shutouts in goal for Cal State San Marcos.

last_match.line: Cal State Monterey Bay have won every match they have played in October; Cal State San Bernardino had not lost at home all season.

next_match.line: Cal State Dominguez Hills have not won since beating Fresno Pacific; Cal State San Marcos kept a clean sheet against Chico State last time out.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
